newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish April budget deficit 40-50 trillion lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkish April budget deficit 40-50 trillion lira.

text.p: Turkey's Finance Minister Abdullatif Sener said on Friday the country's budget deficit in April amounted to 40-50 trillion lira.
Speaking to reporters, Sener said the deficit in March stood at over $1 billion (140.4 trillion lira). Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan had earlier said the March deficit was around this level.
Erbakan, who programmed a balanced budget for 1997 after a deficit of 1,217 trillion lira a year earlier, had said the budget was balanced in January and February.
No official budget figures have been released for January and February.
An IMF delegation visiting Turkey last month said the deficit in the first quarter totalled 415 trillion lira.
